question_en: [03.2] Regarding 'Constitution Governance Panchayati Raj Environment Protection', which statement is most appropriate according to child-centered pedagogy?

explanation_en: Under 'Constitution Governance Panchayati Raj Environment Protection', constructivist and child-centered pedagogy prioritizes prior knowledge, active discovery, and diagnostic support.
